facts.text: Curtain Bluff sits on a rocky promontory on Antigua's south side.
facts.excerpt: Tucked away on a rocky promontory on Antigua's south side

facts.text: The resort is flanked on both sides by the Caribbean Sea.
facts.excerpt: Flanked on both sides by the stunning Caribbean sea

facts.text: Curtain Bluff is a Relais & Chateaux hotel.
facts.excerpt: Curtain Bluff, an award winning Relais & Chateaux hotel

facts.text: All meals and nearly all activities are included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: All meals and nearly all activities are included in your room rate.

facts.text: All accommodations are situated directly on the sand or a few steps from it.
facts.excerpt: All of our accommodations are situated directly on the sand or just a few steps from it

facts.text: The Pool Suites have private plunge pools and marble fixtures.
facts.excerpt: Luxurious features like private plunge pools, marble fixtures and unparalleled views of the sparkling blue Caribbean make our Pool Suites

facts.text: The Terrace Suite sits at the top of the bluff and has a terrace with an infinity-edge plunge pool and daybed.
facts.excerpt: Its 567-square-foot terrace with infinity-edge plunge pool and comfortable daybed is your private sanctuary for intimate relaxation and dining.

facts.text: The Terrace Suite is the most popular choice for newlyweds.
facts.excerpt: make it the most popular choice for newlyweds

facts.text: The bluff suites are split across three levels, with a three-walled open-air living room opening onto a garden patio with a daybed.
facts.excerpt: These light and airy rooms are split across three spacious levels outfitted with natural wood and sea-grass furniture. The three-walled living room offers the best of indoor-outdoor living, opening onto a garden patio

facts.text: The spa sits apart from the rest of the resort just feet from the sea.
facts.excerpt: our 5,000-square-foot spa sits apart from the rest of the resort just feet from the sea

facts.text: The spa's treatment rooms look across the water to Montserrat, Cades Reef, St. Kitts, Nevis and Redonda.
facts.excerpt: treatment rooms boast spectacular views over the water to distant Montserrat, Cades Reef, St. Kitts, Nevis, and Redonda

facts.text: Spa guests can sip tea brewed from fresh herbs picked from the spa's garden and use a cliffside soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: unwind on the terrace sipping tea brewed from fresh herbs picked from the spa's garden. Afterwards, allow your mind to wander and your body to decompress in our luxurious cliffside soaking tub

facts.text: The tennis center has four championship hard courts lit for night play.
facts.excerpt: Our tennis center features four championship hard courts kept in impeccable condition and lit for night play.

facts.text: Curtain Bluff hosts Tennis Challenge Week each November.
facts.excerpt: perhaps the most well-known is Tennis Challenge Week, held here each November

facts.text: A wellness area for adults sits next to the spa.
facts.excerpt: adults only wellness area which is a space adjacent to the spa dedicated to rejuvenation, relaxation and exercise for the body, mind and spirit

facts.text: A pool for adults offers day beds, beverage service and views of Montserrat.
facts.excerpt: Spend the day at the adults only pool where you can enjoy comfortable day beds, beverage service and serene views of Montserrat.

facts.text: Waterskiing, with speedboat, equipment and instruction, is included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: Waterskiing (speedboat, equipment and instruction)

facts.text: Guests can snorkel on Cades Reef and sail the bay on a Hobie Cat.
facts.excerpt: discover the incredible sea life while snorkeling on Cade's reef, skim across the bay on a Hobie Cat

facts.text: The Cee Bee Kids Camp is based in the shade of the palms on the calm-water beach.
facts.excerpt: Headquartered in the shade of the palms on our calm-water beach, Cee Bee Kids Camp is home base for our younger guests.

facts.text: The Tamarind Restaurant sits beneath the resort's tamarind tree and serves a five-course dinner menu that changes.
facts.excerpt: Sheltered beneath the sprawling limbs of our famous Tamarind tree, this dining mainstay boasts expansive breakfast offerings and a locally sourced, ever-changing five-course dinner menu.

facts.text: The wine cellar holds over 25,000 bottles, with private tastings on Thursday afternoons.
facts.excerpt: with over 25,000 expertly sourced bottles. Treat your palate to one of our private tastings, which take place in the cellar on Thursday afternoons

facts.text: The Sea Grape is an open-air restaurant at the far end of the bay beach, right on the sand.
facts.excerpt: At the far end of the bay beach, right on the sand and tickled by near-constant sea breezes, is the Sea Grape.

facts.text: Gardener-led tours of the gardens and nurseries leave from the lobby every Wednesday.
facts.excerpt: tours leave from the lobby every Wednesday at 10:30 AM

facts.text: The Old Road Fund, supported by Curtain Bluff and its guests, was started in 1974.
facts.excerpt: Started in 1974, the Old Road Fund (ORF) is a 501c-3 non-profit foundation supported by Curtain Bluff and its generous guests.

facts.text: Children under age 6 are not allowed in the one-bedroom bluff suite.
facts.excerpt: Children under age 6 are not allowed in the one bedroom bluff suite.

facts.text: Some additional services are not included in the room rate.
facts.excerpt: Additional services (not included in the room rate) :

facts.text: Dinner has a dress code, and at the Tamarind Restaurant gentlemen need slacks, a collared shirt and dress shoes.
facts.excerpt: At dinner, slacks (no jeans) and a collared shirt with dress shoes are required for gentlemen.

facts.text: Pool Suites are described as the crown jewel of the accommodations.
facts.excerpt: make our Pool Suites the crown jewel of Curtain Bluff's accommodations
